title: Horrible Customer Service
body: I love the app and the content is great! However, I have had account access issues for over a month now for a paid subscription. I have sent at least 10 emails and the issue is still not resolved. App and content is 5 stars. Customer service is 1 star.

title: iCloud Connection
body: I recently got this app and it wanted me to sign in with my iCloud ID. I followed the steps, but it said I wasn’t connected in settings. I went to check but I actually was logged in. I tried to restart the app, reinstall the app, and I shut down my phone, but nothing worked!

title: Crumby account setup.
body: If you are going to ask medical professionals to pay for a service at least make sure it works.

title: Doesn’t work!!!
body: I installed this app and it kept wanting me to start an iCloud account which I did but it still doesn’t work. Contact support and they don’t have any suggestions to make it work either! Disappointed since I love the NYSORA videos!

title: Not helpful if I can’t respond to “login to iCloud”
body: It says to set up an iCloud account in settings but there is no settings selection. I’d like to use the app but this is not worth my time to troubleshoot.

title: Come on NYSORA...
body: 6.99 a month? Let’s get serious here. Everything you provide here can easily be obtained (for free) online.... the app is a nice way to access it, but 6.99/month is an untenable amount of money for what you are offering here.

title: Subscribed to online site
body: Unable to access material though a online subscriber. App is requiring that I purchase another subscription to use on mobile app.

title: Needs more blocks
body: Great app that explains the blocks well but only has three blocks in it. It almost like some forgot to finish adding the rest to the app.

title: It'd be great - if it had more than three blocks
body: I've emailed and didn't get a response. The three blocks that are in it are great (interscalene, forearm, and cervical plexus) - well explained, good pictures.

title: Great content but no offline mode
body: It’s a wonderful resource but the last two facilities I’ve been at have had zero phone service and terrible wifi, which have made the app essentially useless.

title: Yearly subscription
body: Can you make an option for a yearly subscription rather than monthly so it can be covered by CME time for a whole year??

title: Incredible, except…?
body: Amazing app! Great information and UI. The only gripe is the (in)ability to turn to landscape mode for mobile (and specifically tablets, which are generally used in landscape orientation). It seems that this has been a common complaint for years, and is really the only thing holding this app back from being the #1 Regional app on the store!

title: Almost perfect
body: I love this app, the content and organization are top notch. It would be perfect if I didn’t have to look at it in portrait mode all the time. I use a bluetooth keyboard for my iPad and it is impossible to use the app while my tablet is in the case. Developers, please, please make it so we can use the app i landscape position. I’m actually typing sideways now to write this review.

title: Needs Bug Fix
body: Latest version doesn’t allow to close a picture once you click it for full size. I have to force close each time to get back to main screen. The “X” button on the left hand side doesn’t work to close the image. Please fix!

title: Almost Perfect
body: Downloaded for facial and scalp blocks, which are not included, unfortunately. Still giving this app five stars because the content that it does have is incredible.

title: Alejandro Abreu
body: No me abre la aplicación

title: Great resource
body: I would love to see the codes added to these blocks to help us coders!!

title: CRNA
body: Excellent app. I use this app to reinforce my regional anesthesia knowledge and techniques. I have attended NYSORA annual course 5 Xs in NYC before it was moved overseas. I always learned something new to improve our practice. Dr Hadzic and his colleagues are excellent teachers. The symposiums were enjoyable and well produced. Please continue to produce new content. Management of > 4000 blocks/year Jim Nitz, CRNA Owner Salem Anesthesia North Carolina USA

title: Different practice
body: I moved to a small town where I am doing regional anesthesia daily. At my old practice, the providers did it in preop and I would do the case. Now that I am in charge of my patients from start to finish, I’ve had to review regional anesthesia. NYSORA APP is amazing. My new colleagues will come get my phone to review blocks that they have not done in awhile. They all want to get this wonderful app.

title: Let’s Get Landscape View
body: Great app! Would love to see it in landscape view on my ipad while the ipad is docked to keyboard folio or magic keyboard. Possible?

title: Nice App
body: App is easy to use and nice for learning. Like new app designe.

title: Well combination between clinical anatomy and ultrasound-guided PNB techniques
body: If you want to master the ultrasound techniques in regional anesthesia within the limited time, it is the best self education materials you can have.

title: Mustafa
body: Great and comprehensive guide to nerve block . Content is constant updated . A must have !

title: Would pay for more info
body: I would be willing to pay $10 (maybe even more) for an app that is updated with more (or all) of the nerve blocks that are listed on the full website (or, at least, USED to be listed). Specifically, I would like Supraclavicular, Popliteal Fossa, Adductor Canal, and Axillary Nerve blocks).

title: Finish the content of the app?
body: Great lay out. Easy to use. But the content is severely limited. ????????

title: Super useful!
body: The best guide for regional nerve blocks out there.

title: Great app
body: Great app with lots of potential!
